summary: The supplied entry is an existing ksb discussion record, despite the reader’s claim that lookup found no entry. All inherited correspondence is retained in entry.md. The proposal adds the first structured stem/sense section, not a duplicate root.

Only kəsbina is textually attested here; 1pl plus d- comparison clause, with zero-marked i=ḥṭiṯayḏe. Arabic derivation is plausible and already discussed in the inherited notes, but no new etymological head text or finite Preterit/citation Infectum is asserted.

The sin construction is one collocation, not a sense split. Permitted lookup finds other guilt/sin idioms under mḥt, nfl and sym, but no matching kəsb combination. The edition’s on ourselves interpretation is retained without treating its wording as an overt Turoyo reflexive phrase.
